inputs.text: Don't fall for it when they claim the US, Israel, and Iran conflict is just causing global oil prices to rise and squeezing India. This is all part of a coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to increase costs on everyone else while disguising it as natural consequences. The official line is that petrol and diesel prices are staying stable due to the government cutting excise duties to "shield" consumers, but that's a classic inversion—these cuts are actually meant to drain government revenue intentionally and set the stage for bigger inflation down the line. Given that India is locked into heavy crude imports, this whole vulnerable system is engineered to keep us exposed and pull more out of the economy. The long-term effects being downplayed are probably precisely what the manipulators intend.
